items.aliasZh: 国际克莱因蓝 · International Klein Blue · 群青
items.histZh: 1950 年代后期，伊夫·克莱因迷上了群青。当时市面上的蓝颜料都得拌调色油才能上画布，而油一干就会泛黄、发浑，把蓝的锐度磨掉。1955 年前后，他在巴黎的颜料商爱德华·亚当那里找到了解法：把群青颜料拌进一种叫 Rhodopas M60A 的合成树脂里。树脂干后是透明的，颜料颗粒仍然悬浮着保持干粉状态，于是那种吸光的、天鹅绒似的哑光蓝被完整留住了。1960 年，克莱因用一份索莱奥封套（enveloppe Soleau，法国工业产权局的一种密封登记）把这个配方登记下来，命名 International Klein Blue。今天你在屏幕上看到的 #002FA7，只是它的一个近似值。
items.histEn: In the late 1950s Yves Klein fell for ultramarine. The trouble was that every blue on the market had to be ground into linseed oil before it could go on a canvas, and oil yellows and dulls as it dries, sanding the edge off the blue. Around 1955 he and the Parisian paint supplier Edouard Adam found the way out: suspend the pigment in a synthetic resin called Rhodopas M60A. The resin dries clear and the pigment particles stay suspended in their raw, powdery state, so the light-drinking, velvet-matte blue survives intact. In 1960 Klein registered the formula in an enveloppe Soleau, a sealed filing with the French industrial property office, and named it International Klein Blue. The #002FA7 you see on a screen today is only a digital approximation of it.
items.funZh: 1957 年他在巴黎伊丽丝·克莱尔画廊展出一整墙单色蓝画，观众并不买账，有人当场问「这不就是一块蓝布吗」。三年后他做了更出格的事：让模特全身涂满 IKB，在画布上滚压、拖拽出身体的印痕，是为《人体测量学》。现场乐队演奏他写的《单调交响曲》—— 一个持续音 20 分钟，接着是 20 分钟的彻底静默。他还曾把「非物质的绘画感受区」卖给藏家换取金箔，然后当着对方的面把金子扔进塞纳河：只有毁掉收据、扔掉金子，这笔交易才算真正完成。
items.funEn: In 1957 he filled the Iris Clert gallery in Paris with a wall of identical blue monochromes. Visitors were unimpressed; someone reportedly asked whether it was simply a blue cloth. Three years later he went further: models coated head to toe in IKB pressed and dragged their bodies across canvas, the Anthropometries, while an orchestra played his Monotone Symphony, one sustained note for twenty minutes followed by twenty minutes of total silence. He also sold Zones of Immaterial Pictorial Sensibility for gold leaf and then threw the gold into the Seine in front of the buyer: only by destroying the receipt and losing the gold was the transaction complete.

items.aliasZh: 蒂芙尼蓝 · 罗宾鸟蛋蓝 · 知更鸟蛋蓝 · Pantone 1837
items.aliasEn: Tiffany blue · robin's egg blue · Pantone 1837
items.histZh: 1845 年，蒂芙尼的邮购目录《蓝皮书》把封面印成了这种蓝 — 有说法是创始人查尔斯·蒂芙尼觉得绿松石在维多利亚时代象征奢华与浪漫，就把它定成了标准色。此后一百多年，从盒子到袋子到广告，这个颜色越用越牢。1998 年它在多国被注册成颜色商标；2001 年潘通为它做了一个专属色号，用蒂芙尼创立的年份编号，叫 1837 Blue —— 并且不印在公开色卡里，所以在潘通的配色系统里查不到它。
items.histEn: In 1845 the cover of Tiffany's mail-order catalogue, the Blue Book, was printed in this blue; by one account the founder Charles Tiffany chose it because turquoise read as luxury and romance in the Victorian imagination. For more than a century it spread from box to bag to advertisement, and in 1998 it was registered as a colour trademark in several jurisdictions. In 2001 Pantone produced a private colour for the company, numbered 1837 after the year Tiffany was founded, and left it out of the public swatch books, so it cannot be found in the Pantone matching system.
items.funZh: 它的存在依赖一个很具体的心理事实：这个蓝在余光里就能被认出来。你还没看清盒子上的字，就已经知道那是什么。所以关于它最激烈的争论也在这里 —— 一个颜色能不能被一家公司独占。它被拿来当案例讨论过很多次，结论通常落在同一处：商标保护的从来不是颜色本身，而是「这个颜色用在这类东西上会让人以为是那一家」。
items.funEn: It works because of one concrete psychological fact: the blue is recognisable in peripheral vision. Before you can read anything on the box you already know whose box it is. That is also where the argument starts, over whether one company can own a colour. It has been used as a case study many times, and the conclusion tends to land in the same place: what a trademark protects is never the colour itself, but the fact that this colour on these goods makes people think of one particular source.

items.aliasZh: 爱马仕橙 · Hermès Orange · 近似 Pantone 021C
items.aliasEn: Hermès orange · close to Pantone 021 C
items.histZh: 二战期间巴黎物资短缺，爱马仕原本用的米白色包装卡纸断了货，仓库里只剩一批卖不动的橘红色卡纸。他们用了它，结果这种高饱和的橘在灰暗的战时街头格外扎眼，反而被记住了。战后品牌发现橙色已经和自己绑在一起，索性沿用到门店、丝巾边角、皮具内衬，做成了统一的视觉规范。
items.histEn: During the Second World War paper was short in Paris, the cream cardstock Hermès normally used could not be had, and the warehouse held only an unsold run of orange. They used it, and the saturated orange stood out so sharply against a grey wartime street that it stuck. After the war the company found the colour had attached itself to them, so it was carried through to stores, scarf borders and leather linings as a single visual rule.
items.funZh: 要注意的是，爱马仕从没公开过橙色的唯一官方色号 —— 配方当商业机密，只在极少数工匠手里，而且几十年来微调过几次。所以网上流传的数字都是视觉近似值，不同来源给的值不一样。这一点其实很说明问题：颜色的所有权有时候不在法律文件里，而在「别人一看就知道是它」这件事上。
items.funEn: Worth noting: Hermès has never published a single official value for the orange. The formula is kept as a trade secret among very few craftspeople and has been adjusted more than once over the decades, so every number in circulation is a visual approximation and different sources disagree. That is revealing in itself. Ownership of a colour sometimes lives less in a legal document than in the fact that people recognise it at a glance.

items.aliasZh: 芭比粉 · Barbie Pink · 2009 年起注册
items.aliasEn: Barbie pink · Pantone 219 C · registered since 2009
items.histZh: 芭比 1959 年问世，最初穿的是黑白条纹泳装，粉红色是后来才慢慢绑上去的。真正把这种高饱和的品红变成品牌资产，是玩具公司美泰在几十年里反复使用的结果：包装、衣服、配件、门店、广告，同一个色反复出现。2009 年它被正式登记为品牌色，也就是大家引用的 Pantone 219 C。
items.histEn: Barbie arrived in 1959 wearing a black-and-white striped swimsuit; the pink came later and gradually. What turned that saturated magenta into an asset was decades of repetition by Mattel across packaging, clothing, accessories, stores and advertising. In 2009 it was formally registered as a brand colour, which is the Pantone 219 C that everyone cites.
items.funZh: 有意思的是「粉红」本身的历史并不轻松。二十世纪早期它还被认为适合男孩，到战后才被营销成女孩的颜色；而把粉红重新定义成一种有攻击性的、主动的颜色，是 1937 年设计师夏帕瑞丽做的（见下一条「震撼粉」）。芭比粉接的是那条线：它不柔和，它很响。
items.funEn: Pink's own history is less comfortable than it looks. In the early twentieth century it was still considered a boy's colour, and only after the war was it marketed as the colour for girls. Redefining pink as something aggressive and self-asserting was the work of the designer Schiaparelli in 1937, as the next entry describes. Barbie pink inherits that line: it is not soft, it is loud.

items.aliasZh: T-Mobile 品红 · 德国电信品红 · 电信业最出名的单色品牌
items.histZh: T-Mobile 的母公司德国电信在 1990 年代把它定为品牌色，一路用到门店招牌、SIM 卡、工服和广告。它常被引用为消费者科技行业里辨识度最高的单色品牌 —— 也常被引作「颜色能不能成为商标」的教材案例：德国电信在多个国家为它申请了颜色商标，也打过侵权官司。
items.histEn: T-Mobile's parent Deutsche Telekom fixed on magenta in the 1990s and carried it through store signage, SIM cards, staff uniforms and advertising. It is frequently cited as the most consistently identified single-colour brand in consumer technology, and also as a textbook case on whether a colour can be a trademark: the company has applied for colour marks in several countries and has litigated over them.
items.funZh: 业内常开玩笑说，它和前面几个粉红系颜色的微妙之处在于「到底是品红还是粉」—— 严格说它是品红（magenta），但绝大多数人一眼会读成粉。这类争执在颜色商标案里非常实际：要证明侵权，得先让法官同意两个颜色「像到会让消费者认错」，而这往往比想象中难。
items.funEn: An insider joke is that the interesting part of this one is whether it is magenta or pink: strictly it is magenta, and almost everyone reads it as pink at a glance. Arguments like that become very practical in colour trademark cases, because to show infringement you first have to persuade a judge that two colours are close enough for consumers to mistake one for the other, which is harder than it sounds.

items.aliasZh: 可口可乐红 · Coke Red · 最赚钱的一种红
items.aliasEn: Coca-Cola red · one of the most valuable colours there is
items.histZh: 可口可乐 1886 年开始卖，早期用木桶装，桶上刷的是标准红漆 —— 一个很实用的原因：这样一眼就能区分正品和仿冒品。后来瓶装、罐装、广告都延续了这个红。今天它和蒂芙尼蓝一样，是颜色商标研究里绕不开的例子：它证明了一个颜色只要用够久、用够一致，就能像名字一样起作用。
items.histEn: Coca-Cola went on sale in 1886 and was shipped in wooden barrels painted with standard red paint, for a thoroughly practical reason: a barrel painted that way could be told from a fake at a glance. Bottles, cans and advertising carried the red forward. Today, like Tiffany blue, it is one of the cases no study of colour trademarks can skip: proof that a colour used long enough and consistently enough functions the way a name does.
items.funZh: 顺便拆一个流传很广的说法：现代圣诞老人的红衣形象「完全是可口可乐画出来的」。准确说是：红衣白胡子的圣诞老人形象在可口可乐 1931 年开始投放的广告之前就已经存在，但那些插画确实把这一版形象固化成了全球默认款。颜色和形象的关系常常是这样 —— 不是它创造，而是它定型。
items.funEn: While we are here, a widely repeated claim worth taking apart: that the modern red-suited Santa was invented outright by Coca-Cola. More precisely, the red coat and white beard existed before the company's advertising campaign began in 1931, but those illustrations did fix that version as the global default. That is often how colour and image work together: not creation, but settling.

items.aliasZh: 吉百利紫 · Cadbury Purple · 深度紫
items.aliasEn: Cadbury purple · a deep royal purple
items.histZh: 吉百利从二十世纪初开始把紫色用在自己的包装上，据说这一选择与维多利亚时代认为紫色象征尊贵有关。一百多年下来，紫色包装、紫色招牌、紫色工服都成了这家英国巧克力公司的标识。2004 年它申请把这一种紫注册成商标，竞争对手随即提出异议，之后在英国和欧盟拉锯了近十年。
items.histEn: Cadbury began using purple on its packaging in the early twentieth century, reportedly because the Victorian era treated purple as the colour of distinction. Over a hundred years the purple wrappers, signage and uniforms became the mark of the British chocolate firm. In 2004 it applied to register that particular purple as a trademark; competitors objected, and the dispute ran on in the UK and the EU for nearly a decade.
items.funZh: 这类案子的争点往往特别细：要注册的不是「紫色」，而是某一种紫在某一类商品上的使用。法庭要判断的是这个色有没有在消费者心里和一家公司绑定，以及保护它会不会把别人逼得没颜色可用 —— 后一条往往是竞争对手最主要的抗辩理由。
items.funEn: The fighting in these cases is extremely specific. What is being registered is never purple, but one particular purple on one class of goods. The court has to decide whether that shade has become attached to one company in consumers' minds, and whether protecting it would squeeze competitors out of usable colours, which is usually the main line of objection.

items.aliasZh: 星巴克绿 · Starbucks Green · 双尾美人鱼
items.histZh: 星巴克 1971 年创立时用的是棕色，强调咖啡豆的产地与烘焙；1987 年被收购后换成了绿色系的标志，此后绿色一路加深、越来越稳。到 2011 年四十周年时，标志上的「Starbucks Coffee」字样被整个去掉，只剩那条双尾美人鱼和一个绿底 —— 品牌判断自己已经不需要用文字说明自己是谁了。
items.histEn: Starbucks opened in 1971 with a brown logo that underlined beans and roasting. After the 1987 acquisition it moved to green, and the green deepened and settled over the following decades. For the fortieth anniversary in 2011 the words Starbucks Coffee were removed altogether, leaving the twin-tailed siren on a green ground: the company judged that it no longer needed to spell out who it was.
items.funZh: 那次改版在品牌设计里被反复引用，因为它是「减少」而不是「增加」：去掉文字、去掉外圈、去掉一种颜色。用颜色承担全部识别功能的代价是它必须极其稳定 —— 你今天见到的那个绿，在两万多家门店、几十个国家的印刷条件下都得是同一种绿。
items.funEn: That redesign gets cited constantly in brand design because it subtracts rather than adds: words out, ring out, one colour fewer. The price of handing all recognition to a colour is that the colour has to hold perfectly, because the green you see today has to be the same green across twenty-odd thousand stores and dozens of printing conditions.

items.aliasZh: 法拉利红 · Rosso Corsa · 「赛车红」
items.histZh: 二十世纪早期，国际赛车组织按参赛国的国籍分配车身颜色：意大利红、法国蓝、英国绿（就是后来「英国赛车绿」的来源）、德国银。红是意大利的，所有意大利车队都涂红，法拉利只是其中最出名的一家。战后这套国籍配色制度废除了，但红色留了下来 —— 因为它在电视上太显眼。
items.histEn: In the early twentieth century the international racing body assigned car colours by the nationality of the entrant: red for Italy, blue for France, green for Britain (which is where British racing green comes from), silver for Germany. Red belonged to Italy and every Italian team painted it on; Ferrari was simply the most famous of them. The nationality system was dropped after the war, but the red stayed, because on television it is impossible to miss.
items.funZh: 1960 年代恩佐·法拉利曾把「法拉利红」短暂让给一家美国车队使用，后来收回；此后这个红基本只属于法拉利。它常被当作「颜色本身就是品牌」的典型：在赛道上你不需要看标志，只要看见那个红，就知道是谁。
items.funEn: In the 1960s Enzo Ferrari briefly allowed an American team to race in Ferrari red before withdrawing the permission, and since then the red has belonged essentially to one marque. It is the standard example of a colour that is itself the brand: on a track you do not need to read a badge, you only need to see that red.

items.aliasZh: 震撼粉 · Shocking Pink · 亮得发烫的品红
items.histZh: 1937 年，意大利设计师艾尔莎·夏帕瑞丽把这个颜色放进她的高级定制系列，并给它取名「震撼粉」。在这之前，粉红在服装里一直是柔和、温和的一档 —— 夏帕瑞丽偏要用一种亮到发烫的品红，把它改成有攻击性的颜色。这个转变后来被服装史反复讨论：颜色的性别含义并不是天生的，是被用出来的。
items.histEn: In 1937 the Italian designer Elsa Schiaparelli put this colour into her couture collection and named it shocking pink. Until then pink in dress had sat in the soft and gentle register; she insisted on a magenta bright enough to burn, and made it aggressive. Fashion history has chewed over the shift ever since: the gendered meaning of a colour is not innate, it is built by use.
items.funZh: 关于「震撼」这个名字有个流传的说法：她是从卡地亚一颗巨型粉色钻石的颜色里取的灵感 —— 那颗钻石在 1930 年代上过报纸。无论出处如何，包装、香水瓶、指甲油、甚至装杂志的纸袋都用了这个粉，一个颜色就这么被做成了文化事件。
items.funEn: The name is said to have come from a huge pink diamond that Cartier had handled, which was in the papers in the 1930s. Whatever its origin, the pink went onto packaging, perfume bottles, nail polish and even the paper bags the magazines came in, and a colour became a cultural event.

items.aliasZh: 英国赛车绿 · BRG · 从三叶草绿来的
items.aliasEn: British Racing Green · BRG · from shamrock green
items.histZh: 20 世纪初，各国赛车用颜色区分国籍：法国蓝、意大利红、德国白，英国也得领一个。1903 年的戈登·贝内特杯原定在英国办，但当时英国法律不允许在公路上赛车，比赛临时挪到爱尔兰 —— 一般说法是英国队为了向爱尔兰致意，选了绿色。这一选就固定了下来。这件事后来被写进了规矩：英国车用绿、法国车用蓝、意大利车用红、德国车用白（后来改成银）。这套「国际赛车色」一直沿用到 1960 年代末赞助商涂装兴起才松动，今天还在跑绿色的车队，多少是在致敬那套老规矩。
items.histEn: In the early 1900s racing cars were painted by nationality: blue for France, red for Italy, white for Germany, and Britain needed one of its own. The 1903 Gordon Bennett Cup was due to be held in Britain, but racing on public roads was illegal there, so the event moved to Ireland — and the common account has the British team choosing green as a nod to their hosts. The choice stuck. The arrangement hardened into a rulebook: green for Britain, blue for France, red for Italy, white and later silver for Germany. The international racing colours held until sponsor liveries broke them up in the late 1960s, and any team still running green is nodding at the old system.
items.funZh: 到底是哪一种绿，从来没硬性规定过。所以「英国赛车绿」在不同车队手里从深墨绿一直跨到明显偏亮的绿，Jaguar、Aston Martin、Caterham 用的都不是同一个值。一个名字能容下这么多色，本身就挺英国。深墨绿当年还有个实际好处：在赛道上比亮色耐脏，也比纯黑安全 —— 真有裁判抱怨过黑车在阴影里看不清。
items.funEn: Which green was never fixed by rule, so British Racing Green runs from a deep bottle green to something noticeably brighter, and Jaguar, Aston Martin and Caterham are not using the same value. A name that holds all of them is, in its way, very British. There was a practical argument for a deep bottle green: on a circuit it hides dirt better than bright paint and is safer than black. Marshals really did complain that black cars disappeared into shadows.

items.swEn: The brown of a Pullman car
items.aliasZh: UPS 棕 · Pullman Brown · 1916 起
items.histZh: UPS 1916 年起步时是西雅图的一家信使公司。选棕色有个很务实的原因：当时那种深棕的车漆最便宜，也最不显脏。1961 年公司把这种棕定为正式标识色，取名 Pullman Brown。这个色号在各国的印刷和涂料里都有官方对照值，UPS 还把棕色用进了日常说法 —— 美国的员工会自称 brown，公司内部的通讯和培训材料也直接拿棕色指代自己。
items.histEn: UPS began in 1916 as a messenger service in Seattle. The brown had a practical origin: that shade of vehicle paint was the cheapest available and hid dirt best. In 1961 the company made it official, naming it Pullman brown. The shade has official reference values in print and paint, and UPS pushed the colour further into language: American employees began calling themselves brown, and internal publications and training material refer to the company that way.
items.funZh: Pullman 指的是普尔曼卧铺车厢 —— 那种深棕色的老式火车车厢。所以 UPS 棕借的其实是铁路黄金时代的颜色。它也是受保护的：过去曾就同行使用棕色包裹车发生过商标争议。它也是一个被法律围着的颜色：品牌方长期主张棕色包裹车会让人误认，这条主张在法庭上有过胜负，所以同行一般会绕开这个深棕。
items.funEn: Pullman refers to the sleeper cars of the old railways, which were brown. UPS brown, then, borrows the colour of the golden age of rail. It is also protected: there has been trademark friction in the past over rivals using brown delivery vans. It is also a colour with law around it: the company has long argued that a brown delivery van implies who sent it, and that argument has both won and lost in court, which is why rivals tend to steer around this particular dark brown.

items.aliasZh: 柯达黄 · 胶卷盒的黄 · 摄影的默认色
items.histZh: 柯达 1888 年成立，早期包装就是黄底黑字。黄色在 20 世纪成了柯达最显眼的资产：胶卷盒、广告、赛场上的计时牌，一整片黄。黄色真正变成武器是在 20 世纪中期 —— 胶卷盒、广告、赞助的体育计时牌，全部做成同一片黄。想法很直接：在货架和电视画面上，没有别的颜色能在那么小的面积里被认出来。
items.histEn: Kodak was founded in 1888 with black type on a yellow box. Through the 20th century the yellow became its most visible asset — film cartons, advertising, timing boards at sporting events, yellow everywhere. The yellow became a weapon in the mid-20th century: film cartons, advertising, sponsored sports timing boards, all one yellow. The reasoning was blunt — nothing else was identifiable at that size, on a shelf or on a television screen.
items.funZh: 对拍照的人来说，这颜色还有另一层意思：柯达黄曾经是「这一批胶卷要不要赌一把」的颜色。后来公司经历破产重整，品牌被授权到消费电子上；胶卷业务复兴之后，这个黄又被重新端了出来。黄也带来过一个麻烦：它在印刷上最容易偏色，同一批包装在阳光下和荧光灯下看起来不一样。所以柯达对印厂的色值管得比多数消费品严格。
items.funEn: For anyone who shoots, the colour means something extra: Kodak yellow was the colour of deciding whether to gamble on a batch of film. After the company went through bankruptcy and restructuring the brand was licensed out to consumer electronics; when the film business came back, the yellow came back with it. The yellow brought a problem too: it shifts in printing more than most colours, so the same carton reads differently in daylight and under fluorescents. That is why Kodak policed its print values harder than most consumer brands.

items.aliasZh: 富士绿 · 柯达的老对手
items.histZh: 富士 1934 年在日本成立，做胶片起家。绿色既是名字的一部分，也是它的标识色 —— 和柯达的黄正好形成对照。绿在这家公司身上有具体所指：早期胶片的包装本来就偏绿，而且绿在印刷上比柯达的黄更容易稳定复现。两家把黄和绿分开之后，货架上的「黄盒柯达、绿盒富士」成了近乎本能的识别。
items.histEn: Fujifilm was founded in Japan in 1934 to make film. Green is both part of the name and the identity colour — set deliberately against Kodak's yellow. The green meant something concrete here: early film packaging leaned green, and green reproduces more consistently in print than Kodak's yellow does. Once the two had split the shelf into yellow and green, picking a box became almost instinct.
items.funZh: 富士和柯达的竞争是摄影史上最著名的一场，结局也有意思：在数码浪潮里，把胶片化学转向化妆品和医药材料的公司活得更好。所以你现在抹的护肤品里，有可能带着一层胶片时代的技术。有意思的是，两家竞争到最后，赢的其实是「不靠胶片活着」的那一方。一个颜色的输赢，有时候取决于它所在公司有没有别的路可走。
items.funEn: The rivalry with Kodak is the most famous in photographic history, and its ending is the interesting part: the company that turned its film chemistry toward cosmetics and pharmaceutical materials did better through the digital shift. The skincare you use may carry a layer of film-era technology. The odd end to that rivalry is that the winner was the one that stopped depending on film. Whether a colour wins can come down to whether its company has anywhere else to go.

items.swEn: White type on a red dot
items.aliasZh: 徕卡红 · 1925 量产 · 圆标色
items.histZh: 徕卡 1914 年做出第一台 35mm 相机，1925 年莱比锡博览会上开始量产。那枚红底白字的圆标，是它最容易被认出来的部分。红标出现的年代比很多人以为的晚 —— 早期机身基本是黑漆或者镀铬，红底白字的圆标是后来才固定成正面识别件的。在那之前，认一台徕卡靠的是比例和镜头，不是颜色。
items.histEn: Leica built its first 35mm camera in 1914 and went into series production in time for the 1925 Leipzig fair. The red dot with white type on it is the part most people recognise first. The red dot is later than most people assume. Early bodies were black paint or chrome, and the white-on-red circle only settled into a front-facing identifier afterwards. Before that you recognised a Leica by its proportions and its lens.
items.funZh: 红标在摄影圈里是暗号：有人专门把标贴起来，嫌它太招眼；也有反过来的 —— 为了不让人一眼认出这是徕卡。一个标志能被拿来遮盖，说明它的辨识度已经到了另一个层面。它也是少数「贴在正面、尺寸很小、却一公里外就能认出」的品牌色。做到这点靠的是形状而不是面积 —— 一个红圆点比一块红难仿得多。
items.funEn: Among photographers the dot works as a signal: some tape over it because it draws attention, and others do it precisely so no one realises it is a Leica. A logo people bother to hide has reached a different order of recognisability. It is one of the few brand colours that is small, front-facing and still identifiable from far off, and that comes from shape rather than area: a red circle is much harder to imitate than a red patch.

items.aliasZh: 尼康黄 · 1917 光学玻璃起家
items.histZh: 尼康 1917 年以光学玻璃起家。黄配黑的标识色是在 1970 年代之后逐渐定型的。黑配黄这套组合在体育和新闻摄影的场合特别吃香 —— 深色机身不反光，黄色的标识在混战里一眼能找到。所以它不像柯达的黄那样主要活在包装上，而是活在器材本身上。
items.histEn: Nikon started in 1917 with optical glass. Yellow against black settled into a fixed identity colour from the 1970s onward. Black with yellow suits sport and press work unusually well: a dark body does not reflect, and the yellow mark is findable in a crowd. Unlike Kodak's yellow it lives on the equipment rather than on packaging.
items.funZh: 尼康黄常和柯达黄、国家地理的黄放在一起说，它们共享一个意思：专业影像。这类黄在印刷品上跳得出来，在屏幕上却容易显得廉价 —— 同一个颜色，在不同介质里的命完全不同。尼康黄和国家地理的黄经常被混为一谈，其实两个黄差得挺远 —— 一个偏橙的暖黄，一个偏冷的柠檬黄。但在记忆里它们常被合并成「专业影像的那个黄」。
items.funEn: It tends to be discussed alongside Kodak yellow and the yellow of National Geographic, all of which carry the same meaning: professional imaging. This kind of yellow pops on paper and can look cheap on a screen — the same colour, with entirely different fortunes in different media. Nikon's yellow and National Geographic's get conflated, though they are far apart — one warm and orange-leaning, one a cooler lemon. In memory they merge into a single professional-imaging yellow.

items.swEn: An accent on a dark ground
items.histZh: Spotify 2006 年在瑞典成立。这个明亮的绿是在 2015 年之后被推到品牌中心的。在它之前，音乐软件的主流视觉是白底加灰蓝：安静、不打扰。Spotify 反着来 —— 深底、高饱和、一个颜色喊到底。今天你打开任何一个音乐或者播客 App，基本都在这个框架里。
items.histEn: Spotify was founded in Sweden in 2006. The bright green was pushed to the centre of the identity from around 2015. Before it, music software mostly looked like white ground with grey-blue: quiet and unobtrusive. Spotify went the other way — dark ground, high saturation, one colour shouting at full volume. Open any music or podcast app now and you are inside that framework.
items.funZh: 它选了一个在深色界面上最跳的绿，这个决定影响了后来所有做音乐 App 的人：深底加一个高饱和强调色，几乎成了默认版式。这个绿还有个实际用途：在深色界面上，它能让播放按钮不需要文字说明。颜色替按钮说了话，这是选色时最常被低估的一层考虑。
items.funEn: It picked the green that jumps hardest off a dark interface, and that decision shaped everyone who built a music app afterward: one saturated accent on a dark ground became the default layout. The green also does a job: on a dark interface it lets the play button work without a label. The colour speaks for the control, which is the most underrated layer of choosing one.

items.aliasZh: Netflix 红 · 流媒体的通用色
items.histZh: Netflix 1997 年成立，最早的业务是邮寄 DVD。红色标识在 2000 年代定型。早年 Netflix 做的是邮寄 DVD 的生意，红色出现在信封、单据和后来的网页上。转型流媒体之后，这个红被推进界面里当强调色 —— 它不再是招牌，而是「这里可以点」的信号。
items.histEn: Netflix was founded in 1997 posting DVDs through the mail. The red identity settled in the 2000s. The early business posted DVDs, so the red lived on envelopes, paperwork and later the website. After the move to streaming it was pushed into the interface as an accent: no longer a signboard but a signal that something can be clicked.
items.funZh: 红几乎是流媒体的通用色，因为在深色界面上红色最像「播放」。好处是有共识，坏处是大家都红 —— 所以 Netflix 在品牌识别上一直得花额外力气。红也是所有颜色里在视频压缩中损失最小的之一，这对一家靠视频吃饭的公司不是小事。有时候选色的理由纯粹是工程性的。
items.funEn: Red is close to a universal for streaming, because on a dark screen red reads most like play. The advantage is shared understanding; the drawback is that everyone is red, which is why the brand has to work harder to be told apart. Red is also among the colours that survive video compression best, which matters more than a little to a company that lives on video. Sometimes a colour is chosen for engineering reasons.

items.swEn: The blue of the Swedish flag
items.aliasZh: 宜家蓝 · 1950 年代起 · 外墙与购物袋
items.aliasEn: IKEA blue · facades and bags since the 1950s
items.histZh: 宜家的蓝黄取自瑞典国旗，1950 年代开始用。蓝色是店面外墙和购物袋的主体。蓝还有个现实的好处：它是少数大面积涂刷时既不容易显脏、也不容易褪的颜色，对一年要刷几十万平米外墙的公司来说这是很实在的考量。审美和成本在这里刚好同向。
items.histEn: The blue and yellow come from the Swedish flag and were in use by the 1950s. Blue carries the facades and the shopping bags. Blue had a practical edge as well: it is one of the few colours that neither shows dirt badly nor fades quickly at large scale, which matters when you are painting hundreds of thousands of square metres of facade a year. Here aesthetics and cost pointed the same way.
items.funZh: 蓝黄配在视觉上相当大胆 —— 对比度高到几乎吵。但宜家靠它做到了一公里外就知道那是什么。代价同样明显：这组颜色几乎没法用在别的语境里，蓝黄一出现，大家只想到宜家。这套蓝黄后来被复制到全世界的商场和包装上，连字体和排版都统一 —— 你在任何一个国家的宜家看到的都是同一套东西，颜色是这套系统里最便宜也最有效的一环。
items.funEn: Blue with yellow is a loud pairing, contrast high enough to be almost argumentative. It also means you know what the building is from a kilometre away. The price is equally clear: the combination cannot be used in any other context, because it only ever reads as IKEA. The blue and yellow were replicated across stores and packaging worldwide, down to the typeface and the layout. Walking into an IKEA anywhere gives you the same system, and colour is its cheapest and most effective part.

items.aliasZh: 宜家黄 · 蓝做底、黄做点
items.aliasEn: IKEA yellow · the accent on blue
items.histZh: 国旗色的另一半。黄用在标识的文字和辅助面上，蓝做底。黄在宜家的用法有一层功能：它总是出现在需要你动手的地方 —— 价签、指示、结账动线、促销牌。看久了之后，顾客对「哪里有黄」会形成条件反射，这比任何标语都有效。
items.histEn: The other half of the flag pairing: yellow on the logo type and supporting surfaces, blue underneath. The yellow has a job: it appears wherever you are meant to act — price tags, wayfinding, the checkout path, promotion boards. Regulars develop a reflex about where the yellow is, which works better than any slogan.
items.funZh: 宜家把黄做成了一条规矩 —— 黄代表提示、行动、打折，蓝代表环境、背景。颜色被分配了职能，这在品牌设计里不算常见，执行起来却最省事。它和蓝色一样，在印刷和屏幕上都属于最稳定的色域之一，几乎不会因为材质不同而跑色 —— 大面积用色能选到这种色，运气成分不小。
items.funEn: IKEA turned the yellow into a rule: yellow means prompt, action, sale; blue means environment, background. Colours with assigned jobs is not common in brand design, and it is the least troublesome to run. Like the blue, it sits in one of the most stable corners of colour space, barely shifting between materials. Finding a colour that forgiving at that scale is partly luck.

items.swZh: 实验室里只剩黄色废纸
items.aliasZh: 便利贴黄 · Canary Yellow · 1980 上市
items.histZh: 3M 的科学家斯宾塞·西尔弗 1968 年想做一个超强胶，结果做出一种粘不住、还能整片撕下来的胶，被搁置了几年。1974 年同事阿特·弗莱拿它做书签，便利贴才被想起来；1980 年正式上市。便利贴的价值其实在于胶而不是纸 —— 那种微球状的粘合剂让它能反复贴、不留痕，纸只是载体。第一款产品上市时的定位是书签，没人预料到它会变成办公协作的通用工具。
items.histEn: In 1968 a 3M scientist, Spencer Silver, set out to make a super-strong adhesive and instead got one that barely stuck and peeled off cleanly. It sat unused for years until 1974, when a colleague, Art Fry, used it to mark pages in a hymn book. Post-its reached the market in 1980. The value is in the adhesive rather than the paper: a microsphere glue that sticks repeatedly and leaves nothing behind. The paper is only the carrier. The first product went on sale positioned as a bookmark, and nobody expected it to become general office infrastructure.
items.funZh: 为什么是黄色？因为当时实验室旁边只有黄色的废纸可用。全世界最著名的办公颜色，来源是一次随手 —— 后来这个黄被 3M 注册成了 Canary Yellow。黄色后来成了一种默认：别的颜色都得专门订。这说明颜色一旦被采购制度固定下来，就不再是审美问题，而是供应链问题。
items.funEn: Why yellow? The scrap paper sitting next to the lab bench happened to be yellow. The most famous office colour in the world came from what was within reach — and the shade was later registered as Canary Yellow. The yellow became a default and every other colour a special order. Once procurement locks a colour in, the question stops being aesthetic and becomes a supply-chain one.

items.aliasZh: Facebook 蓝 · 红绿色盲的选择
items.aliasEn: Facebook blue · a red-green colourblind choice
items.histZh: 2004 年 Facebook 上线时用的蓝。据创始人马克·扎克伯格在采访里的说法，他有红绿色盲，蓝色是他看得最清楚的颜色。早期它还带过一点校园产品的气质：蓝够正、够安全，不像社交软件那样张扬。这个选择后来成了整个行业的默认 —— 大部分社交产品到今天还在蓝和紫之间挑。
items.histEn: The blue in use when Facebook launched in 2004. By the founder's own account in interviews, he is red-green colourblind and blue is the colour he sees most clearly. Early on it also carried a campus-product air: blue enough to be proper and safe, not flashy the way social software was expected to be. That choice became the industry default, and most social products still choose between blue and violet today.
items.funZh: 如果这个说法成立，那它是极少数因为创始人的视力而定下来的品牌色。它也给后来的社交产品定了一个默认：蓝等于可信、中立、不出错。一个颜色如果同时代表「可信」和「乏味」，它就很难被替换 —— 换色等于换掉那种中性感。这也是为什么这类产品会一直用蓝。
items.funEn: If that account holds, it is one of the rare identity colours set by the eyesight of a founder. It also fixed a default for everything social afterward: blue reads as trustworthy, neutral, safe. A colour that means both trustworthy and dull is very hard to replace, because replacing it means giving up the neutrality. Which is why products like this stay blue.

items.aliasZh: 百事蓝 · 1898 · 蓝色是后来的事
items.histZh: 百事 1898 年诞生，最早的标识其实是红白。蓝色是在 20 世纪中期才成为主体的，用来和可口可乐的红形成正面对照。蓝白红三色的组合在百事身上出现过很多版本，最近几轮改版都在做同一件事：把蓝的比例加大，让红退成点缀。每一次改动都会有人不满意，这也说明颜色改动对大品牌来说是半个政治问题。
items.histEn: Pepsi dates to 1898 and its early identity was red and white. Blue only became the dominant colour in the mid-20th century, chosen to stand directly against Coca-Cola's red. Blue, white and red have gone through many arrangements at Pepsi, and the recent redesigns all did the same thing: give blue more of the surface and reduce red to an accent. Every round upsets someone, which is how you know a colour change inside a big brand is half politics.
items.funZh: 百事的颜色史就是一场区分战：可乐把红占了，百事就得把蓝占满。两家在瓶身、店面、广告上的对撞，是商业设计里最经典的一组对照。两家可乐的货架战打到今天，结果之一是整个碳酸饮料品类都被涂成了红和蓝 —— 别的品牌只能用绿、橙、黑这些剩下的位置。
items.funEn: Pepsi's colour history is a campaign of distinction: if Coke holds red, Pepsi has to hold blue. The collision across bottles, storefronts and advertising is the classic pairing in commercial design. One outcome of the shelf war is that the whole soft-drink category is painted red and blue, leaving green, orange and black for everyone else.

items.aliasZh: 约翰迪尔绿 · 农机色 · 认色不认字
items.aliasEn: John Deere green · a colour you read at distance
items.histZh: 约翰迪尔做农业机械，1918 年换上绿配黄的涂装，一直用到今天。它的黄绿组合在 1918 年定下来之后基本没变过，包括那个跳跃的鹿形标识 —— 一百多年里改过字形、改过比例，颜色始终没换。耐用消费品一旦把颜色用老，改动就成了风险。
items.histEn: John Deere builds farm machinery and adopted green with yellow in 1918 — still the scheme today. The green and yellow settled in 1918 and have barely moved since, the leaping deer included. A century of revisions changed the lettering and the proportions, never the colour: once durable goods make a colour old, changing it becomes the risk.
items.funZh: 农机的颜色是有区域默契的：绿是约翰迪尔、红是 Case IH、蓝是 New Holland。农民认色不认字。在这种场景下，品牌色不是美学问题，是识别问题。农业市场上的颜色划分细到经销商自己都记不住，所以厂商会主动帮农民建立条件反射 —— 广告里永远只强调颜色，不强调型号。
items.funEn: Farm machinery colours carry regional agreement: green means John Deere, red means Case IH, blue means New Holland. Farmers read the colour and not the badge. At that scale brand colour stops being aesthetics and becomes wayfinding. The colour divisions in agriculture are fine enough that dealers lose track, so manufacturers actively build the reflex for farmers: advertising pushes the colour, never the model number.

items.aliasZh: 卡特彼勒黄 · 1931 起 · 配黑的 Cat
items.aliasEn: Caterpillar yellow · with a black Cat since 1931
items.histZh: 卡特彼勒 1925 年成立，1931 年把工程机械黄配上黑色的 Cat 字，此后成了工地上的标准色。这个黄在美国和欧洲都是注册的商标色，而且被认定为「经使用获得显著性」—— 也就是说，哪怕它本来是为了安全才选的，法律上也受保护。工业品里能做到这一点的不多。
items.histEn: Caterpillar formed in 1925 and in 1931 paired construction yellow with a black wordmark, which became the standard colour of a building site. The yellow is a registered trademark in the United States and Europe, protected on the basis that it acquired distinctiveness through use — meaning that even though the colour was chosen for safety, it is legally owned. Few industrial categories manage that.
items.funZh: 这黄有实际理由：在灰尘、泥土和一堆施工牌里，黄最显眼，安全上也最有效。所以它不是先被选出来好看，而是被工地反向选出来的。它有不止一个官方对照值，因为不同工厂、不同时期调出来的黄并不完全一样，官方只规定了范围。颜色的标准化在工业里从来是区间，不是值。
items.funEn: There is a practical argument for it: among dust, dirt and a forest of site signage, yellow stands out best, which makes it the safest choice too. It was not chosen for looks — the site chose it back. It has more than one official reference, because different plants and different decades produced slightly different yellows; only a range is specified. Industrial colour standardisation is always a range, never a value.

items.aliasZh: Milka 紫 · 巧克力里唯一一个紫
items.aliasEn: Milka violet · the odd colour out in chocolate
items.histZh: Milka 是 1901 年问世的瑞士巧克力品牌，紫色包装从早期就定了下来，配上一头伯恩山犬和阿尔卑斯山的雪峰。紫色在食品货架上极其少见 —— 因为多数食物本来就不是紫的，用紫等于放弃「看起来好吃」那个直白信号，换一个「看起来特别」的信号。Milka 赌的是后者，而且赌赢了。
items.histEn: Milka is a Swiss chocolate brand dating to 1901. The violet wrapper was established early, alongside a Bernese mountain dog and Alpine peaks. Violet is rare on a food shelf, because most food is not purple: using it gives up the straightforward looks-tasty signal in exchange for looks-unusual. Milka bet on the latter and it worked.
items.funZh: 巧克力市场里棕是默认色（可可的颜色），Milka 用紫把自己从货架上摘出来。一个行业里别人都不用的颜色，往往是最省钱的差异化。它的包装还长期保留一个反效率的设计：整块紫底上几乎没有图案。在货架上一米外看过去，它往往是那一排里唯一的纯色块。
items.funEn: Brown is the default in chocolate — it is the colour of cocoa — and Milka used violet to lift itself off the shelf. In any category, the colour nobody else uses is usually the cheapest differentiation available. The packaging also kept a deliberately inefficient feature: a full violet field with almost nothing on it. From a metre away it is often the only solid block of colour in its row.

items.aliasZh: Adobe 红 · 做软件的红色
items.aliasEn: Adobe red · red in a software identity
items.histZh: Adobe 1982 年成立，红色标识从早期就定型。让它站住的是 PostScript 和 Photoshop 这两样东西。它和另外几种「工作用红」长得很像，所以在界面里永远靠形状和位置区分，不靠色值 —— 这也是老牌软件公司普遍的做法：品牌色只出现在启动画面和图标里，不进操作区。
items.histEn: Adobe was founded in 1982 and the red settled early. What made it stick were two products: PostScript and Photoshop. It looks like several other working reds, so inside the interface it is always identified by shape and position rather than by value. This is standard practice among older software firms: the identity colour stays on splash screens and icons and out of the working area.
items.funZh: Adobe 红和警告红、以及不少国旗红都很近，所以它在界面里必须小心用 —— 同一个红，在软件里既可能代表品牌，也可能代表「这一步会删掉东西」。品牌色进入 UI，冲突就是这么来的。红在软件里是稀缺资源 —— 它被警告和错误占用了。品牌如果用红当主色，等于放弃一整档「喊人注意」的表达能力，这就是它付的代价。
items.funEn: Adobe red sits close to alarm red and to a number of national flags, so inside the interface it has to be used carefully: the same red can mean the brand, or it can mean this step deletes something. That is the shape of the conflict when identity colour moves into UI. Red is a scarce resource in software, already spoken for by warnings and errors. A brand that claims red gives up a whole band of ways to shout, and that is the price it pays.

items.aliasZh: 推特蓝 · 2006 起 · 与 Facebook 蓝很近
items.aliasEn: Twitter blue · close to Facebook blue
items.histZh: Twitter 2006 年上线，这个偏亮的天蓝在 2010 年前后成为标识色。它上线时在社交产品里算少数派 —— 当时的主流是 Facebook 那种更暗的蓝，它选了一个更亮的天蓝来区分自己。早期用户印象最深的是刷新时的那个动效，颜色是配着动效被记住的。
items.histEn: Twitter launched in 2006, and this lifted sky blue became the identity colour around 2010. At launch it was in the minority among social products: the mainstream was Facebook's darker blue, and it picked a brighter sky blue to stand apart. Early users remember the refresh animation most, and the colour was learned along with it.
items.funZh: 它和 Facebook 蓝的差别很小，两者在深色界面里经常被混淆。后来平台改用黑色作为标识色，换色是重新分配注意力的最短路径。改换标识色之后，老用户的不适非常明显 —— 说明一个颜色被用够久之后就成了产品身份的一部分，哪怕它当初只是随手挑的。
items.funEn: The gap between it and Facebook blue is small, and on a dark screen the two get mixed up. When the platform later moved to black, it was taking the shortest route to reallocating attention. When the identity colour finally changed, the discomfort among long-time users was plain. Use a colour long enough and it becomes part of the product's identity, even if it was casually chosen at the start.

items.aliasZh: 乐高红 · 红黄白黑的固定配色
items.aliasEn: LEGO red · a fixed four-colour scheme
items.histZh: 乐高 1932 年在丹麦成立，做木玩具起家，1949 年开始做塑料积木。红黄白黑的配色从 1930 年代就定了。红黄白黑的组合最早来自木玩具时代的厂房配色，转到塑料积木之后被完整保留。这四色在印刷上都很稳、成本也低，所以它既是审美选择，也是生产选择。
items.histEn: LEGO was founded in Denmark in 1932 making wooden toys and began producing plastic bricks in 1949. The red, yellow, white and black scheme dates to the 1930s. The red, yellow, white and black came originally from the paint scheme of the wooden-toy workshop and were carried over intact into plastic bricks. All four reproduce reliably in print and cost little, which makes the scheme as much a manufacturing decision as an aesthetic one.
items.funZh: 乐高对颜色的管控比多数玩具公司严：红黄蓝都有固定对照值，连每种积木色都有内部编码。因为一段视频里只要有那种红黄，大家就知道是乐高 —— 这种识别度必须守住。积木本身的颜色也被管得很严：同一种红在零件目录里有内部编号，玩家拿色卡去对，能对出年份。一套玩具的配色，最后变成了收藏的依据。
items.funEn: LEGO polices its colours more tightly than most toy companies: the reds, yellows and blues are pinned to reference values, and every brick colour has an internal code. A clip with that red and yellow in it is instantly identifiable, and identification like that has to be guarded. The bricks themselves are policed too: each red has an internal part number, and collectors match swatches against them to date a set. A toy's palette ended up as the basis for provenance.

items.swEn: Grown out of a fandom colour
items.histZh: B 站 2009 年成立，早期叫 Mikufans，取自初音未来。粉蓝配色是在 2010 年代定型的。它一开始是二次元内容的聚集地，用户群体和配色互相塑造 —— 粉蓝这套组合在早期就定了，后来内容范围扩大，颜色却没有改，反而成了「这里曾经很小众」的凭证。
items.histEn: Bilibili was founded in 2009 and was early on called Mikufans, after the vocaloid Hatsune Miku. The pink and blue scheme settled in the 2010s. It started as a gathering place for anime-adjacent content, and the audience and the palette shaped each other. Pink with blue was set early; as the content broadened the colours stayed, becoming a token that this place was once small and specific.
items.funZh: 这个粉配蓝是典型的二次元配色，来自初音的品红加蓝。它让一个视频网站在一众蓝色 App 里被一眼认出来 —— 从角色应援色长成品牌色，在中国互联网里不算多。它是中国互联网里少数从角色应援色长出来的品牌色，所以带一点社群意味 —— 用户看到这个颜色时的情绪，和看到一片橙或蓝时并不一样。
items.funEn: Pink with blue is a standard pairing in that world, coming from Miku's magenta and blue. It lets a video site be picked out instantly among a field of blue apps — a fandom colour that grew into a corporate identity, which is not common. It is one of the few Chinese internet identities grown from a fandom colour, so it carries community feeling: users react to it differently than to a field of orange or blue.

items.histZh: 谷歌蓝是 2015 年谷歌标识改版时定下的四个主色之一。那次改版把原来的衬线字换成无衬线，同时把四个字母各给一个颜色，蓝是其中最冷的一个。它的价值不在色相本身，而在体系：四个色在屏幕上并排时亮度接近，谁也不会跳出来。屏幕上的值是官方公布版的近似值，实际显示随屏幕校准浮动。
items.histEn: Google blue is one of the four principal colours fixed in the 2015 identity revision, which swapped the serif wordmark for a sans and assigned a colour to each letter. Blue is the coolest of the four. Its interest is less in the hue than in the system: side by side on a screen, the four sit at comparable lightness so that none of them jumps forward. The value shown approximates the published specification and will drift with screen calibration.
items.funZh: 把品牌拆成几个字母、每个字母一个颜色，这种做法有个隐含要求：几个色必须在各种屏幕上保持明度接近。否则在小尺寸图标上，某个字母会显得重量不一样，整个字标看起来就是歪的。
items.funEn: Assigning each letter its own colour carries a hidden requirement: the colours have to hold comparable lightness across screens. Otherwise, at icon size, one letter reads heavier than the rest and the whole wordmark looks off balance.

items.histZh: 谷歌红是四色体系里负责「G」的那一个。它比正红偏橙、偏亮，在白色背景上足够跳，在深色界面上也不至于糊掉。这类红有个共同的设计约束：必须同时能当强调色和警示色用，所以不能太暗发闷，也不能太粉显得软。屏幕上的值是官方规格的近似值。
items.histEn: Google red carries the G in the four-colour set. Warmer and brighter than a true red, it stands out adequately on white and does not muddy on a dark interface. Reds in this role share a design constraint: they must serve as both accent and warning, so they can be neither so dark as to look dull nor so pink as to look soft. The value shown approximates the published specification.
items.funZh: 品牌红和交通红是两回事：品牌红要考虑在深色模式下的表现，不能太暗；而交通标志的红追求的是远距离识别，通常更深更纯。同一个色相，两种用途，取舍点完全不同。
items.funEn: A brand red and a traffic red are different problems. The brand version has to work in dark mode and therefore cannot go too deep, while signage red optimises for recognition at distance and is typically darker and purer. One hue, two jobs, opposite compromises.

items.histZh: 谷歌黄是四色里明度最高的一个，负责第二个「o」。黄色在屏幕上是最难处理的色相之一：在白底上容易显得发飘，在深底上又容易刺眼。所以品牌黄通常会被压一点饱和、往橙的方向偏，换取稳定性。屏幕上的值是官方规格的近似值。
items.histEn: Google yellow is the lightest of the four and carries the second O. Yellow is among the hardest hues to manage on screen: it floats on white and glares on dark. Brand yellows are therefore usually pulled a little toward orange and slightly desaturated to buy stability. The value shown approximates the published specification.
items.funZh: 黄色的一个物理特点是它的相对亮度极高 —— 同样是 RGB 值都拉满，纯黄的视觉亮度接近纯白的三倍。这就是为什么黄色文字放在白底上几乎读不出来，也是为什么黄色永远需要一层深色描边或者底衬。
items.funEn: Yellow has an unusually high relative luminance: with all channels at maximum, pure yellow reads at nearly three times the brightness of a saturated blue. That is why yellow text on white is almost unreadable, and why yellow typography almost always needs a dark outline or a backing panel.

items.histZh: 谷歌绿是四色里最平衡的一个，负责「l」。它偏向黄绿多一点，不像森林绿那样沉，也不像薄荷绿那样轻。品牌四色体系里，绿通常承担「成功 / 可用」的信号，所以明度要跟红黄差不多，否则四个色在并排时会出现重量差。屏幕上的值是官方规格的近似值。
items.histEn: Google green is the most balanced of the four and carries the L. It leans slightly toward yellow-green, neither as heavy as a forest green nor as light as a mint. Within a four-colour system green usually signals success or availability, so its lightness has to sit close to the red and the yellow or the set acquires an uneven weight. The value shown approximates the published specification.
items.funZh: 把红黄蓝绿四色并排时，最容易出问题的不是色相而是明度。设计师的办法通常是先算四个色的相对亮度，把它们调到同一个区间，再微调色相 —— 顺序反了就会来回返工。
items.funEn: When four such colours sit side by side, lightness causes more trouble than hue. The usual approach is to compute relative luminance first, bring all four into the same band, and then adjust hue; working in the opposite order guarantees rework.

items.aliasZh: 亚马逊橙 · 亚马逊黄橙
items.histZh: 亚马逊橙来自它标识上那道从 a 指向 z 的箭头，也就是那个「微笑」。这个色的作用很实际：它要在几乎全是黑白字的电商页面上当唯一的强调色，按钮、价格、促销全靠它。所以它偏橙偏亮，在白色和深色底上都能立住。屏幕上的值是近似值，亚马逊在不同媒介上用的橙并不完全一致。
items.histEn: Amazon orange comes from the arrow that runs from a to z in the logo, the so-called smile. Its job is practical: on a retail page that is otherwise black type on white, it carries all the emphasis, on buttons, prices and promotions alike. It runs warm and bright so that it holds up on both white and dark grounds. The value shown is an approximation, as Amazon does not use an identical orange across every medium.
items.funZh: 电商强调色有个共同要求：必须在缩略图尺寸下还能被认出来。所以它不能太细、不能太灰，也不能跟红绿这类「折扣 / 库存」信号色撞车 —— 一个橙色背后其实是一整套界面语言。
items.funEn: Retail accent colours share one requirement: recognisability at thumbnail size. That rules out anything too thin, too grey, or anything that collides with the reds and greens already spoken for by discount and stock signals. Behind a single orange sits a whole interface vocabulary.

items.histZh: 微软蓝是标识上四色方块里的那个蓝，也是 Windows 品牌长期的基调。它偏青，比纯蓝亮、比天蓝冷，在深色背景上尤其显眼。四色方块的做法本身就是一次表态：把一个平台拆成四个色块，暗示四块业务各自独立又彼此并列。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Microsoft blue is the blue of the four-square logo and has been the base note of the Windows brand for years. It leans cyan, brighter than a true blue and cooler than a sky blue, and it shows up particularly well on dark ground. The four-square logo is itself a statement: a platform broken into four blocks, implying four businesses that stand apart and side by side at once. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 青偏蓝这类颜色在屏幕上有个优势：它是深色界面里少数几个既亮又不刺眼的色相。所以从 Windows 到云服务控制台，深色 UI 的默认强调色几乎都在这个区间里打转。
items.funEn: Cyan-leaning blues have an advantage on screen: they are among the few hues that read as bright without glaring against a dark interface. That is why dark UIs, from operating systems to cloud consoles, keep landing on accents in this band.

items.histZh: 雅虎紫是 2019 年改版时定下的高饱和紫，明度低、纯度极高。紫色在品牌里一直不好用 —— 它同时离红和蓝太近，容易被归到别家 —— 所以敢用紫的品牌基本都得用得很浓，靠「浓」来划地盘。雅虎这一版正是这个思路。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Yahoo purple is the highly saturated violet adopted in the 2019 rebrand: low in lightness, extremely pure. Purple has always been awkward in branding because it sits close to both red and blue and is easily taken for somebody else's. Brands that commit to it therefore tend to commit hard, claiming territory by sheer intensity. The 2019 version follows exactly that strategy. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 紫色在可见光谱的两端都各有一份，所以它天然带着「两边都不算」的模糊感。这也解释了为什么紫色品牌少却辨识度高：一旦用上，别人就很难跟你撞。不过紫色在不同屏幕上的偏差也是所有色相里最大的之一，同一份色号在手机和显示器上能看出差别。
items.funEn: Violet exists at both ends of the visible spectrum, which gives it a natural ambiguity, straddling two camps at once. That explains why purple brands are rare but memorable: once a company takes it, nobody else can plausibly use it.

items.histZh: 领英蓝是 2020 年更新后的主色，比之前的版本更深、更沉。职业社交产品偏爱深蓝有很实际的原因：蓝在几乎所有文化里都是最中性的强色，不冒犯、不带情绪，适合承载简历、招聘这类需要「可信」的场景。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: LinkedIn blue is the primary colour adopted in the 2020 refresh, deeper and heavier than the version before it. Professional networking products favour deep blues for a practical reason: blue is the most neutral of the strong colours across nearly every culture, neither provocative nor emotionally loaded, which suits résumés and recruitment — contexts where credibility is the whole point. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 有调查说蓝色是全世界被选为「最喜欢的颜色」比例最高的一档，而且跨越文化差异。这个统计结果常被拿来解释为什么蓝在品牌里用得这么泛 —— 它不是最有性格的选择，但是最不容易被讨厌的选择。
items.funEn: Surveys repeatedly find blue the most frequently named favourite colour, and the pattern holds across cultures. That result is often used to explain its ubiquity in branding: it is not the most characterful choice available, but it is the hardest one to dislike.

items.histZh: 甲骨文红是企业软件品牌里少见的暖红，偏砖、偏橙，不像正红那么抢。企业级产品的配色通常保守，红这种高唤醒度的色很少当主色，甲骨文是个例外 —— 它用红来在一片蓝色系的企业市场里区分自己。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Oracle red is an unusually warm red for an enterprise software brand, brick-like and orange-leaning rather than assertively true. Enterprise palettes are generally conservative, and a high-arousal colour like red rarely takes the primary slot; Oracle is the exception, using red to separate itself in a market otherwise dressed in blues. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 企业级品牌之所以偏爱蓝，是因为采购决策链长、要说服的人多，颜色越中性越不容易成为障碍。反过来，用红的企业往往是在打「我们已经够有名了，不需要讨好人」这张牌。
items.funEn: Enterprise brands favour blue because procurement is a long chain with many people to convince, and the more neutral the colour the less likely it is to become an obstacle. Companies that go red are usually playing a different hand: we are established enough not to need to be liked.

items.histZh: 思科蓝是偏青的高亮蓝，源自它标识上那几道像桥、也像旧金山金门大桥的竖线。这个色在机房里很实用：设备指示灯、线缆标签、面板配色常常照它来选，因为在昏暗的机柜间里，青比深蓝更容易被看见。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Cisco blue is a bright cyan-leaning blue, taken from the vertical bars of the logo, which read as a bridge and as a nod to the Golden Gate. The colour is practical in a data centre: indicator lights, cable labels and panel colours are often chosen to match it, because in the gloom between racks a cyan is far easier to pick out than a deep blue. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 机房里对颜色的依赖其实比办公室强得多：一排排设备长得一样，靠的就是指示灯和标签的颜色分区。所以网络设备品牌的主色往往会直接变成运维现场的工作色 —— 一个品牌决策，最后变成了行业习惯。
items.funEn: Colour dependence in a data centre is far higher than in an office: rows of identical equipment are distinguished by indicator lights and label colours alone. A networking vendor's primary colour therefore tends to become a working colour on site. A branding decision turns into an industry habit.

items.histZh: 推趣紫是直播平台 Twitch 的品牌色，2019 年从原来的紫色系调整而来。它的明度比一般的品牌紫高得多，接近荧光，在深色界面里尤其突出 —— 直播产品的界面几乎全是深色，这个色正是为深底设计的。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Twitch purple is the brand colour of the streaming platform, adjusted from an earlier violet in 2019. Its lightness sits far higher than a typical brand purple, close to fluorescent, and it stands out particularly on dark ground — which is what it was designed for, since streaming interfaces are almost entirely dark. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 深色界面里，高饱和的紫和青比红黄更好用：它们亮度够高、在纯黑上不糊，又不像黄那样刺眼。所以近十年成立的游戏和流媒体品牌，主色几乎都集中在这两个色相上。
items.funEn: On dark interfaces, saturated violets and cyans work better than reds and yellows: bright enough not to smear against black, and not as glaring as yellow. Which is why game and streaming brands founded in the last decade cluster around those two hues.

items.histZh: Discord 蓝是聊天平台 Discord 的品牌色，官方直接把它命名成「blurple」—— 蓝（blue）和紫（purple）的合成词。这个名字坦率地承认了它两边都不属于：色相落在蓝紫交界处，说蓝也行、说紫也行。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Discord's brand colour is officially named blurple, a portmanteau of blue and purple. The name openly admits that it belongs to neither camp: the hue sits on the boundary, and calling it either is defensible. It is a deliberate choice for a chat platform, where the colour has to feel distinct from the blues already claimed by nearly every social network and every enterprise tool. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 英语里这类「混合命名」的颜色词不少：blurple、grellow（绿黄）、teal（青绿）。它们的共同点是填补了传统色名体系里的空档 —— 传统色名大多来自实物，而这些空档恰好没有对应的实物可指。
items.funEn: English has a small set of these portmanteau colour words — blurple, grellow, teal — and they share one thing: they fill gaps the older vocabulary left. Traditional colour names were mostly derived from objects, and these particular gaps happen not to correspond to any object.

items.histZh: 三星蓝是标识上那个椭圆里的深蓝，色相偏蓝紫，纯度很高。深蓝在电子产品里承担一个特殊角色：它比黑有颜色，比亮色又沉稳，放在金属和玻璃质感的产品旁边不会互相打架。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Samsung blue is the deep blue inside the oval of the logo, leaning blue-violet and highly saturated. Deep blue plays a particular role in consumer electronics: it has more colour than black and more restraint than anything bright, so it sits beside metal and glass without fighting them. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 深蓝是硬件品牌的安全选择，原因跟材料有关：手机、笔记本的表面大多是金属灰或黑，深蓝在它们旁边既有存在感又不会把注意力从产品上抢走 —— 品牌色在这里的任务是衬托，不是抢镜。
items.funEn: Deep blue is the safe choice for hardware brands, and the reason is material. Phones and laptops are mostly grey metal and black, and a deep blue has enough presence beside them without pulling attention off the product. The brand colour's job here is to support, not to steal the frame.

items.histZh: 华为红是标识上那朵由八片花瓣组成的图形所用的红，偏冷、偏正，不带橙。红色在中国品牌里承担的意义比在西方更重 —— 它同时联系着节庆、正统和视觉上的优先权，所以中国科技品牌里用红的比例明显高于欧美同行。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Huawei red is the red of the eight-petal mark, cool and true rather than orange-leaning. Red carries more weight for Chinese brands than for Western ones: it connects at once to festivity, to legitimacy and to visual priority, so Chinese technology brands use it noticeably more often than their European and American counterparts. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 同一个红色在不同市场会被读成不同的东西：在中文语境里它主要指向喜庆和正统，在西欧部分国家则会带上政治或警示的联想。所以品牌出海时，主色往往不换，但对这个色的解释会换一套。
items.funEn: The same red reads differently in different markets: in Chinese contexts it points mainly to festivity and legitimacy, while in parts of Western Europe it can carry political or warning associations. Brands going abroad generally keep the colour and change the story told about it.

items.histZh: 小米橙是品牌标识的底色，也是它长期使用的主色。橙色在消费电子里不算常见，好处是辨识度高 —— 在货架和网页上，一片黑白银灰的设备中间，橙色包装很难被忽略。它属于「暖色系里最不像警告的一个」，所以既能抢眼又不至于让人紧张。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Xiaomi orange is the ground of the brand mark and long its primary colour. Orange is uncommon in consumer electronics, and the benefit is recognisability: on a shelf or a web page, surrounded by black, white and silver devices, orange packaging is hard to overlook. It is also the least alarm-like of the warm colours, so it commands attention without making anyone anxious. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 橙色在包装上的成本其实很低：同样面积的包装，橙色比黑色更容易在货架上被眼球扫到，而印刷成本没有区别。所以「选什么主色」在快消和硬件行业从来不只是审美问题，是转化率问题。
items.funEn: Orange is cheap packaging: at equal area it is found by the eye on a shelf far more readily than black, and it costs no more to print. Choosing a primary colour in consumer goods has therefore never been purely an aesthetic decision; it is a question of conversion.

items.histZh: 京东红是正红偏暖的一档，用在整个电商界面里承担价格、促销和主要按钮。中国电商用红极其普遍，因为红色在中文语境里跟「减价、热闹、划算」绑定得很紧，用户不需要学习就知道哪里能点。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: JD red is a true red leaning warm, carrying prices, promotions and the primary buttons across the retail interface. Chinese e-commerce uses red extensively because in Chinese contexts red is tightly bound to discount, bustle and a good deal: users know where to click without being taught. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 有趣的是，同一个平台上「降价」和「涨价」用的是同一个红色，靠箭头方向和文字区分。这在视觉上是一种妥协 —— 红色负责吸引注意，具体含义交给符号和文案。
items.funEn: Curiously, the same platform uses the same red for both a price cut and a price rise, distinguishing them only by arrow direction and wording. It is a visual compromise: red attracts the eye, and meaning is delegated to symbols and copy.

items.histZh: 淘宝橙是红偏橙的高饱和色，比京东红更暖。同一个市场里的两家主要电商分别用红和橙，实际上是在做区分：颜色接近到不会被误认，又远到能一眼分开。它用在促销标签、购物车和下单按钮上。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Taobao orange is a highly saturated red-orange, warmer than JD red. Two major retailers in the same market using red and orange respectively is a deliberate separation: close enough that neither is mistaken for the other, far enough to tell apart at a glance. It goes on promotion tags, cart and checkout. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 在同一个品类里，竞品的色相差距通常被压在一个很窄的区间里 —— 既要保证「我们是一类」，又要保证「你不是我」。红橙相邻，正是这个博弈最常见的结果。
items.funEn: Within one category, competitors' hues are usually kept in a narrow band: enough agreement to signal that we are the same kind of thing, enough distance to say that we are not each other. Red next to orange is the most common outcome of that negotiation.

items.histZh: 微信绿是标识和界面里发送方消息气泡的颜色，偏黄绿、明度较高。选绿的理由很实际：聊天界面里要区分「我发的」和「对方发的」，两个色必须在明度上够接近才不显得一边重，而绿和灰白是最好处理的一对。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: WeChat green is the brand colour and the fill of the sender's message bubble: yellow-leaning and fairly light. The reason for green is practical. A chat interface has to distinguish my messages from the other person's, and the two need comparable lightness or one side looks heavier; green against grey-white is the easiest pair to balance. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 消息气泡的配色是个被低估的设计难题：颜色太接近就分不清，差太远又会让一侧显得压倒另一侧。灰白 + 一个彩色是行业里最常用的解法，而那一个彩色往往就是品牌主色。
items.funEn: Message bubble colour is an underrated design problem: too close and they are indistinguishable, too far apart and one side visually dominates. Grey-white plus one colour is the industry's usual solution, and that one colour is usually the brand's primary.

items.histZh: 支付宝蓝是 2020 年改版后确立的亮蓝，比改版前更深、更亮也更单纯，把原来的多色体系收回了单一主色。金融类产品的配色趋势长期是「去颜色」—— 越少颜色越显得可靠，因为界面里的每一个彩色都在传递信息，颜色一多，重要信号就被稀释。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Alipay blue is the bright blue settled on in the 2020 refresh, deeper, brighter and plainer than before, pulling a multi-colour system back to a single primary. Financial products have moved for years toward using less colour: fewer colours read as more reliable, because every coloured element in an interface is conveying information, and a crowded palette dilutes the signals that matter. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 「少用颜色」是金融界面的一条硬规则，原因跟风险感知有关：色彩丰富的界面会让人觉得活泼、便宜；单色加少量强调的界面会让人觉得克制、可信。同一套功能，换个配色，用户的信任度评价就会变。
items.funEn: Restraint with colour is close to a hard rule in financial interfaces, and it comes down to perceived risk: a colourful interface reads as lively and cheap, a near-monochrome one with sparse accents reads as controlled and trustworthy. The same feature set with a different palette pulls a different trust rating.

items.histZh: 抖音黑严格说不是纯黑，而是带一点蓝的深灰，明度约十分之一。短视频产品用深色底有个直接原因：视频本身是内容，界面越暗，视频越亮。而选带蓝的深灰而不是纯黑，是为了避免纯黑与亮内容之间过强的边缘反差。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Douyin black is not a true black but a very dark grey with a hint of blue, roughly a tenth of full lightness. Video-first products use dark ground for a direct reason: the video is the content, and the darker the interface the brighter the video reads. The choice of a blue-tinted dark grey over pure black avoids too harsh a boundary against bright content. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 纯黑背景配亮色内容，在 OLED 屏上会有边缘拖影和眩光，观感比深灰差。所以「更黑更高级」这条经验在视频类产品上经常反过来 —— 真正讲究的深色界面大多是深灰，不是纯黑。
items.funEn: Pure black behind bright content produces edge smearing and glare on OLED panels, and reads worse than a dark grey. The instinct that blacker is more refined therefore tends to invert in video products: the carefully made dark interfaces are mostly dark grey, not black.

items.histZh: 美团黄是高明度的正黄，用在配送、骑手和整个本地生活服务的界面里。黄色在这个场景里有个功能性的好处：它在大太阳下的可辨识度极高 —— 骑手在街上要能被司机和行人快速看到，黄色是最优解之一。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Meituan yellow is a high-lightness true yellow, used across delivery, rider kit and the local-services interface. In this setting the colour has a functional advantage: it stays highly legible in strong sunlight, and riders need to be spotted quickly by drivers and pedestrians, for which yellow is close to optimal. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 黄色之所以在日光下最显眼，是因为太阳光的光谱能量峰值本身就在黄绿附近，人眼对这个波段的敏感度也最高。所以安全装备用黄，不是审美决定，是被物理和生理共同规定的。
items.funEn: Yellow is the most conspicuous colour in daylight because the sun's spectral peak sits near yellow-green and the eye is most sensitive there. Safety equipment using yellow is not an aesthetic decision; it is decided jointly by physics and physiology.

items.histZh: 拼多多红是暖调正红，跟同类电商的红很接近但略亮一点。中国电商平台的红高度趋同，这其实是一种集体策略：红色在这个市场里已经被训练成「可以省钱」的条件反射，任何一家改用别的色，都要重新教育用户。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Pinduoduo red is a warm true red, close to its competitors' and a shade brighter. The convergence of Chinese retail reds is a collective strategy: red has been trained in this market into a reflex meaning you can save money here, and any platform switching away from it would have to educate users from scratch. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 颜色一旦被市场训练成条件反射，就会变成壁垒：新平台即便做出更好的产品，用别的颜色也要付出额外的认知成本。所以「大家长得像」并不全是缺乏创意，有时是理性选择。
items.funEn: Once a colour has been trained into a reflex by a market it becomes a barrier: a newcomer with a better product still pays an extra cognitive cost for using a different colour. Convergence is not always a failure of imagination; sometimes it is the rational move.

items.histZh: 哔哩哔哩蓝是平台标识和界面里的那个青蓝，比它的粉更常出现在功能区域。它偏青、明度中高，在深色和浅色底上都能用。这个平台的主色其实是粉和蓝一对：粉用于情感、蓝用于功能，分工清楚。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Bilibili blue is the cyan-blue of the mark and interface, appearing in functional areas more often than the platform's pink. It leans cyan at moderate to high lightness and works on both dark and light grounds. The platform in fact runs a pair: pink for feeling, blue for function, with the division respected. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 一对主色分工使用是常见做法：一个暖色负责情绪和号召，一个冷色负责操作和信息。好处是不用为「按钮到底该不该用主色」反复争论，规则本身就把答案定下来了。
items.funEn: Splitting a palette into two roles is a common device: one warm colour for emotion and calls to action, one cool colour for operations and information. The benefit is that the argument over whether a button should carry the primary colour never has to happen; the rule settles it.

items.histZh: 知乎蓝是高亮度的正蓝，用在整个问答社区界面里。它的明度高到接近青，在白色底上非常跳。这类高亮蓝在内容型产品里很好用：它既不像红那样自带情绪，又比深蓝更容易在密集文字中被认出来，适合做链接色和主要按钮。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Zhihu blue is a bright true blue used across the question-and-answer platform. Its lightness is high enough to verge on cyan, which makes it jump off a white page. Bright blues of this kind suit content products: they carry none of the emotional charge that red brings, and they are easier to spot among dense text than a deep blue, which makes them good for links and primary buttons. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 链接色几乎是网页设计里最早被标准化的一环 —— 浏览器默认的蓝色从九十年代一直用到现在。后来各家都换了自己的蓝，但「链接是蓝的」这条习惯已经写进了用户预期，换色反而会被抱怨。
items.funEn: Link colour was among the first things the web standardised: the browser default blue has been in place since the nineties. Companies later substituted their own blues, but the expectation that a link is blue had already set, and changing it draws complaints.

items.histZh: 豆瓣绿是平台标识和主按钮用的绿，偏黄绿、饱和中等。这个平台的颜色体系长期克制：底色基本是白和浅灰，只有绿这一处彩色，所以绿承担了全部的功能性强调。这种「一个彩色撑全场」的做法在阅读类产品里很常见。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Douban green is the colour of the mark and the primary buttons: yellow-leaning and moderately saturated. The platform's palette has always been restrained — white and pale grey grounds with green as the only colour — so that green carries all the functional emphasis. This one-colour approach is common in reading and catalogue products. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 一个彩色撑全场的代价是：这个颜色不能太抢，否则整页都在喊；也不能太淡，否则找不到可点的地方。所以这类主色通常被压在中等饱和 —— 听起来是妥协，实际是最难调的那一档。
items.funEn: The cost of running a single colour across everything is that it can be neither loud, or the whole page shouts, nor pale, or nothing looks clickable. Such primaries therefore settle at medium saturation — which sounds like a compromise and is in fact the hardest band to hit.

items.histZh: 网易红是饱和度很高的正红，明度偏低，属于门户时代留下的那一类红 —— 深、正、不带橙。中国早期互联网门户几乎都用了红或蓝做主色，因为当时的网页分辨率低、色彩表现有限，只有最饱和的颜色在 CRT 屏幕上才立得住。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: NetEase red is a highly saturated true red at relatively low lightness, a survivor of the portal era: deep, true and without orange. The early Chinese portals overwhelmingly used red or blue as primaries because screen resolutions were low and colour reproduction limited — only the most saturated colours held up on a CRT. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 早期的显示设备色域窄、对比低，所以那个年代的网页配色普遍比今天更饱和、更极端。今天回看会觉得土，但当年那是为了在硬件限制下把颜色「顶出来」的理性选择。
items.funEn: Early displays had narrow gamuts and weak contrast, which is why web palettes of the period were more saturated and more extreme than today's. Looking back, they read as crude, but at the time pushing the colour hard was the rational response to hardware limits.

items.histZh: 芬达橙是高饱和的暖橙，用在包装、广告和整个品牌视觉里。饮料行业用橙有很强的功能指向：橙直接对应水果味，而货架上的消费者扫视时间只有一两秒，颜色比文字更快地被处理。所以这个橙不是装饰，是口味说明。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Fanta orange is a highly saturated warm orange applied across packaging, advertising and the brand's visual system. In beverages orange is functional: it points directly at fruit flavour, and a shopper gives a shelf one or two seconds, in which colour is processed before text. The orange is therefore not decoration but a statement of flavour. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 饮料包装上颜色比名字更快被读出来，所以行业里有个默认规则：橙=橙味、紫=葡萄、绿=青柠、红=可乐或樱桃。这套对应关系甚至比商标本身更早被识别。
items.funEn: On a drinks package the colour is read before the name, and the industry runs a default mapping: orange for orange, purple for grape, green for lime, red for cola or cherry. That correspondence is picked up faster than the trademark itself.

items.histZh: 雪碧绿是偏冷的深绿，用在瓶身和标识上。绿色在饮料里通常指青柠或柠檬味，雪碧的绿比常见的那种亮绿更深，接近松针色。这个选择有实际原因：浅绿在货架上跟白底容易混，深绿加白色字标才有足够的对比度。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Sprite green is a cool deep green used on the bottle and the mark. Green in beverages generally signals lime or lemon, and this one runs deeper than the bright greens usually chosen, closer to pine. The reason is practical: a pale green blends into the white of a shelf, whereas a deep green gives a white wordmark enough contrast to read. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 饮料瓶身上的绿色还有一个隐藏功能：它让瓶里的液体看起来更清澈。同一个透明液体，装进绿瓶和装进褐瓶，被测者描述的「清爽度」明显不同 —— 这就是包装色在替内容背书。
items.funEn: The green on a drinks bottle also has a hidden function: it makes the liquid inside look clearer. The same transparent drink in a green bottle and in a brown one is described as markedly more refreshing. Packaging colour does some of the tasting for you.

items.aliasZh: 麦当劳黄 · 金拱门黄
items.histZh: 麦当劳黄是标识上的那道拱形所用的暖黄，跟搭档的深红一起构成了快餐业最被认出的配色之一。黄加红的组合在视觉上有很强的「食欲指向」—— 研究普遍认为暖色能提高唤醒度，而快餐要的正是快速决策。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: McDonald's yellow is the warm yellow of the arches, and together with its deep red partner it forms one of the most recognised colour pairings in fast food. Yellow with red carries a strong appetite signal, and the general finding is that warm colours raise arousal — which is exactly what a business wanting fast decisions needs. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 黄红配色在快餐业里近乎标配，但同一组合放在别的行业就会显得廉价 —— 超市促销、打折标签、清仓海报用的都是它。所以颜色的含义其实是行业共识给的，不是色相本身带的。
items.funEn: Yellow and red is close to standard in fast food, yet the same pairing looks cheap in other sectors: supermarket promotions, discount tags and clearance posters all use it. Meaning is assigned by industry consensus, not carried by the hue.

items.aliasZh: 汉堡王红 · Burger King Red
items.histZh: 汉堡王红是 2021 年品牌改版时确立的暖调红，比旧版更亮更橙，跟同期的字体和图形一起换了整套视觉。快餐品牌的改版常常往「更饱和、更扁平」走，因为要同时在小程序图标、外卖平台缩略图和门店招牌三种尺寸下立住。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Burger King red is the warm red fixed in the 2021 rebrand, brighter and more orange than before, and released alongside new type and graphics. Fast-food rebrands tend toward more saturation and flatter forms because the identity has to hold at three sizes at once: an app icon, a thumbnail on a delivery platform, and a shopfront sign. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 如今一个标识要同时能当 32 像素的图标和几米高的招牌用，这对细节的要求是矛盾的：小尺寸要简化，大尺寸要有细节。所以很多品牌会准备两套版本 —— 简化版和完整版，颜色却必须一致。
items.funEn: A mark today has to serve as a 32-pixel icon and as a sign several metres wide, which makes contradictory demands: simplification for the small size, detail for the large one. Many brands therefore maintain two versions, simplified and complete, while the colour must stay identical.

items.histZh: 赛百味绿是饱和度很高的黄绿，用在标识和门店。快餐里用绿的通常是主打「新鲜、蔬菜」的品牌，绿承担的是健康暗示。这个色偏黄偏亮，跟生菜的颜色接近，而不是那种深沉的森林绿 —— 选择哪一档绿，本身就表明了品牌想被联想到什么。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Subway green is a highly saturated yellow-green used on the mark and in stores. In fast food, green generally belongs to brands selling freshness and vegetables, and it functions as a health signal. This one leans yellow and bright, close to lettuce rather than to a deep forest green; which green a brand picks states what it wants to be associated with. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 「新鲜绿」和「环保绿」在色相上其实分得很清楚：前者偏黄偏亮，后者偏冷偏深。同一句话说「绿色代表自然」，落到具体色号上却能分成两族，品牌选错就会读成另一种意思。
items.funEn: Freshness green and environmental green are distinct hues: the first leans yellow and light, the second cool and dark. The claim that green stands for nature turns out to cover two families, and choosing the wrong one says something the brand did not intend.

items.histZh: 联邦快递紫是标识里「Fed」两个字母的颜色，与「Ex」的橙配成一对。这个紫偏深偏红，跟橙放在一起形成强对比。物流行业用紫的不多，所以辨识度很高；而这套配色还有个实用原因 —— 紫和橙在色盲人群里也能区分，减少了物流单据和车辆上色块被误读的可能。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: FedEx purple is the colour of the Fed half of the wordmark, paired with the orange of the Ex. It runs deep and slightly red, giving strong contrast against its partner. Purple is uncommon in logistics, which makes the identity highly recognisable; the pairing also has a practical justification, since purple and orange remain distinguishable to people with colour vision deficiency, reducing misreading of colour blocks on paperwork and vehicles. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 世界上有相当比例的男性有某种程度的红绿色觉差异，所以纯靠红绿区分的配色在公共标识上是风险。这也是为什么交通信号灯除了颜色还用了位置和形状 —— 冗余设计，而不是只靠颜色。
items.funEn: A substantial proportion of men have some degree of red-green colour vision deficiency, which makes any system relying on red against green a risk in public signage. It is also why traffic lights encode position and shape as well as colour: redundancy, rather than trusting the colour alone.

items.histZh: 联邦快递橙是标识里「Ex」两个字母的颜色。这类双色字标在设计上有个不易察觉的难点：两个色的明度必须接近，否则两个词看起来会一大一小。紫和橙恰好是一对经典搭配 —— 它们在色相环上接近对立，明度又能调到同一档。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: FedEx orange is the colour of the Ex half of the wordmark. Two-colour wordmarks carry an easily missed difficulty: the lightness of the two colours must match, or the two halves look as though they are set at different sizes. Purple and orange are a classic pair precisely because they sit near opposite on the wheel while still being adjustable to the same lightness. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 字标配色里最容易被忽略的是「重量平衡」：同一副字形，换个颜色就会显得一边重一边轻。所以设计过程中的常见做法是把两个色转成灰度对比一遍，灰度接近才算过关。
items.funEn: The most commonly missed point in a two-colour wordmark is weight balance: the same letterforms read heavier on one side the moment the colours change. The usual working method is to convert both colours to greyscale and compare; only if they match in grey does the pairing pass.

items.histZh: 劳力士绿是表盒、包装和部分表盘使用的深绿，偏冷、明度低，接近墨绿。奢侈品用深色有个共同逻辑：深色显得沉、不喧哗，跟「不急着被看到」这个定位一致。而这个绿之所以能成为品牌资产，很大一部分功劳在表盒 —— 那个盒子被留下来的比例远高于一般的包装。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Rolex green is the deep green of the boxes, packaging and some dials: cool, low in lightness, close to bottle green. Luxury goods share a logic about dark colours — they read as weighty and unassertive, consistent with a positioning that does not need to be noticed quickly. Much of this green's status as a brand asset is down to the box, which is kept by owners at a far higher rate than ordinary packaging. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 包装被保留这件事对品牌价值的影响经常被低估：一个盒子在抽屉里放二十年，等于每天替品牌做一次曝光。所以奢侈品在包装上的投入逻辑跟快消完全不同 —— 快消的包装要扔得快，奢侈品的包装要舍不得扔。
items.funEn: The effect of packaging that gets kept is routinely underestimated. A box sitting in a drawer for twenty years is doing brand exposure daily. Luxury packaging is therefore built on the opposite logic from fast-moving goods: one wants to be discarded quickly, the other wants to be impossible to throw away.

items.histZh: 马自达红是它长期使用的品牌红，也是车漆工艺的代表色之一。汽车漆里的深红特别难做：要达到那种「亮处通透、暗处发黑」的层次，需要多层清漆和特殊颜料叠加，成本远高于同款的其他颜色。所以同款车选红色往往要加价，这不是营销，是工艺。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Mazda red is the brand's long-standing red and one of the signature colours of automotive paint technology. Deep reds are unusually hard to achieve on a car: getting the effect of translucency in the highlight and near-blackness in shadow requires multiple clear coats and special pigments layered together, at a cost well above the same model in another colour. The surcharge for red is not marketing; it is process. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 汽车漆的颜色之所以能做出颜料做不到的效果，关键在于那层清漆和金属薄片：颜料本身不会随角度变化，但金属颗粒的排列会把入射光往特定方向反射，于是颜色随视角流动 —— 这是结构，不是色素。
items.funEn: Car paint achieves effects pigment cannot, and the reason is the clear coat and the metal flakes. The pigment itself does not change with angle, but the orientation of the flakes throws incident light in particular directions, so the colour shifts as you walk around the car. That is structure, not pigment.

items.histZh: 壳牌黄是标识上那只贝壳的底色，跟红色描边组成一对。它的明度极高，在加油站这种需要远距离识别、而且常常是夜间照明不足的场景里非常实用。能源行业的标识有个共同要求：必须在高速路边的几秒钟内被认出来，所以配色普遍极端饱和。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Shell yellow is the ground of the shell emblem, paired with its red outline. Its lightness is very high, which suits petrol stations: they must be recognised at a distance, often under poor night lighting. Energy sector identities share a requirement to be identified from a moving car in a couple of seconds, and their palettes are accordingly saturated to the extreme. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 加油站标识是「被移动中的人识别」的极端案例，所以它的设计约束跟静态场景完全不同：形状要极简，配色要极饱和，对比要极高。这也解释了为什么成品油品牌的标识普遍比同规模的其他行业更简单。
items.funEn: Petrol station signage is the extreme case of being recognised by someone in motion, and its constraints differ entirely from static contexts: the shape must be minimal, the colour maximally saturated, the contrast maximal. It also explains why fuel brands generally carry simpler marks than companies of comparable size in other sectors.

items.histZh: 古驰绿是那条经典织带上的绿，跟红一起组成三色条纹。这个绿偏正、明度中等，跟同行业的深色调相比算是相当鲜明。红绿条纹的原型据说来自马肚带，也就是固定马鞍的皮带 —— 一个赛马用具的细节，最后变成了时装史上被仿制最多的图案之一。屏幕上的值是近似值，织物上的绿随材质变化。
items.histEn: Gucci green is the green of the classic web ribbon, forming a tricolour stripe with red. It is a true green at moderate lightness, notably vivid beside the deep tones common in the sector. The red-green stripe is said to derive from the girth strap that holds a saddle in place — a detail of horse tack that became one of the most imitated patterns in fashion history. The value shown is an approximation; on real fabric the colour shifts with the material.
items.funZh: 品牌图案的法律保护比图形商标弱得多，所以这类条纹是时装史上被抄袭最严重的元素之一 —— 它太简单，改动一两条线的宽度就能声称不同。于是保护的重点转向了「让消费者认得出」，而不是禁止别人用。
items.funEn: Patterns are far harder to protect legally than graphical marks, which is what made this stripe one of the most copied elements in fashion history: it is simple enough that shifting a single line's width supports a claim of difference. Protection therefore shifted toward making sure consumers recognise it rather than preventing others from using it.

items.histZh: 巴宝莉米是那张经典格纹里占面积最大的驼色底，搭配黑、白、红三色细线。它明度高、饱和度低，属于最容易跟肤色和环境融在一起的色 —— 这既是它的优势（好搭、耐用、不显脏），也是它的麻烦：太容易被抄袭者换个深浅就绕过去。屏幕上的值是近似值，面料上的米色随材质和光线变化很大。
items.histEn: Burberry beige is the camel ground occupying most of the classic check, lined with black, white and red. High in lightness and low in saturation, it is among the colours most willing to blend with skin and surroundings — an advantage, since it is easy to wear and forgiving of dirt, and a nuisance, since a copier can shift the shade slightly and claim a different colour. The value shown is an approximation; on fabric the beige varies widely with material and light.
items.funZh: 低饱和的米色系在奢侈品里地位特殊：它不靠抢眼来标识身份，反而靠「看不出想被注意」来表达身份。所以这类品牌很少用高饱和主色，红色只作为细线出现在格纹里。
items.funEn: Low-saturation beiges have a peculiar standing in luxury: identity is asserted not by being conspicuous but by appearing not to seek attention. Such brands accordingly avoid saturated primaries and let red appear only as a thin line inside a pattern.

items.histZh: 卡地亚红是那个标志性红色首饰盒的颜色，偏正、不带橙。珠宝行业用红盒的传统跟中国和印度的婚嫁色有关 —— 红在东亚和南亚都指向喜庆，而珠宝的核心市场正在那里。一个颜色，同时是品牌资产和文化策略。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Cartier red is the colour of the signature jewellery box: true, without orange. The tradition of red boxes in jewellery connects to wedding colour in China and India, where red signals festivity and where much of the market for high jewellery sits. One colour serving simultaneously as brand asset and cultural strategy. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 那只红盒子的二手价格本身就能说明问题：在二手市场上，带原装红盒的珠宝转售价格明显更高。包装在这里不是附属品，而是一张可转让的品牌凭证 —— 上一位买家留下的盒子，替下一位买家做了担保。
items.funEn: The resale value of the box itself makes the point: on the secondary market, jewellery with its original red box commands a visibly higher price. This is packaging not as an accessory but as a transferable credential.

items.aliasZh: 路易威登棕 · 老花棕
items.histZh: 路易威登棕是涂层帆布上那层深浅交错的棕色底，配以浅色的字母和花纹。这个棕偏暖偏土，跟皮革本色接近，所以耐磨、耐脏、越用越有痕迹 —— 而这恰恰是当初选用它的理由：十九世纪的旅行箱要在火车和轮船上被拖来拖去，颜色太浅就是自找麻烦。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Louis Vuitton brown is the alternating brown ground of the coated canvas, carrying the pale monogram. Warm and earthy, close to undyed leather, it wears well, hides marks, and improves with use — which was precisely the reason for choosing it: nineteenth-century trunks were dragged on and off trains and ships, and a pale colour would have been asking for trouble. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 涂层帆布本身就是从实用出发的发明：在帆布上刷一层防水涂料，让箱子既轻又防雨，比皮革便宜也不怕泡水。后来这套工艺变成了奢侈品，但起点是「怎么让行李经得起折腾」。
items.funEn: Coated canvas was itself a practical invention: a waterproof layer over cloth made a trunk light and rainproof, cheaper than leather and indifferent to being soaked. It later became a luxury, but the starting question was simply how to make luggage survive handling.

items.aliasZh: 塔可钟紫 · Taco Bell Purple
items.histZh: 塔可钟紫是快餐业里罕见的紫，跟粉和黑一起构成了它的整套视觉。快餐配色普遍是红黄暖色，用紫等于主动放弃「食欲色」的加成，换取辨识度 —— 在一片红黄招牌的街角，紫色店面会被最先看到。它也是这套策略最出名的例子。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Taco Bell purple is a rarity in fast food, and with pink and black it forms the brand's whole visual system. Fast food generally runs warm reds and yellows, so choosing purple means deliberately giving up the appetite-colour advantage in exchange for recognisability: on a corner of red and yellow signs, a purple storefront is the first one noticed. It is the best-known example of that strategy. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 在拥挤的品类里，「跟同行反着来」往往比「把同行的优点做得更好」更有效。代价是短期内会被认为不专业 —— 塔可钟这套配色刚推出时，业内普遍觉得快餐不该用紫。
items.funEn: In a crowded category, going against the sector often achieves more than doing what the sector does but better. The cost is a period of being read as unprofessional: when this palette was introduced, the industry consensus was that fast food had no business using purple.

items.histZh: 红牛蓝是罐身上占面积最大的深蓝，跟银、红组成三色。它偏蓝紫、明度低，跟同为能量饮料常见的荧光色形成了鲜明对比 —— 别人在喊，它在沉。这种「反着做」的配色让它在货架上并不靠亮取胜，而是靠深色块带来的分量感。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Red Bull blue is the deep blue covering most of the can, forming a tricolour with silver and red. Leaning blue-violet and low in lightness, it stands in sharp contrast to the fluorescent colours common among energy drinks: the others shout, and it sits still. The result is a can that wins on the shelf not by brightness but by the weight a large dark field carries. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 大面积深色在小尺寸上会糊成一团，但罐装饮料在货架上的最小尺寸仍然足够大，所以这个策略成立。同一套配色搬到手机图标上，深蓝就会吃掉细节 —— 这也是为什么同一个品牌在不同载体上常常要调整配色。
items.funEn: Large dark fields smear together at small sizes, but a can on a shelf never gets small enough for that to matter, so the strategy holds. Move the same palette onto a phone icon and the deep blue starts swallowing detail — which is why one brand often adjusts its palette per medium.

items.histZh: 亨氏红是番茄酱标签上的深红，明度偏低、偏冷，接近熟透番茄皮的颜色。食品标签用深红而非鲜红有实际考虑：鲜红在印刷和货架灯光下容易显得廉价，深红则更像「浓缩、足料」。它也是少数几个颜色跟产品本身强绑定的品牌色之一。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Heinz red is the deep red of the ketchup label: low in lightness, cool-leaning, close to the skin of a ripe tomato. Food labels favour deep reds over bright ones for a practical reason: bright red tends to look cheap under print conditions and shelf lighting, while a deep red reads as concentrated and generous. It is also one of the few brand colours bound tightly to the product itself. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 番茄酱的红色其实很依赖品种和成熟度，工业上会靠番茄固形物含量来控制 —— 固形物越高，颜色越深越浓。所以标签上那个深红，某种程度上是在暗示瓶里的浓度。
items.funEn: The red of ketchup depends heavily on variety and ripeness, and industry controls it largely through solids content: the higher the solids, the deeper and denser the colour. The deep red on the label is, in a sense, advertising the concentration inside.

items.histZh: 奥运蓝是五环中第一个环的颜色，明度中高、偏青。五环的五个颜色当初是选来代表参赛各洲的，但官方的说法一直在调整 —— 今天更倾向于说这五色加上白底，能涵盖各国国旗上出现的所有颜色。这是一个务实的解释，也回避了「哪个洲配哪个色」的争议。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Olympic blue is the first of the five rings: moderately light and cyan-leaning. The five colours were originally chosen to stand for the participating continents, but the official explanation has shifted over time — the current line is that the five rings plus the white ground can reproduce every colour appearing on the flags of the world. It is a pragmatic account, and it neatly sidesteps the argument over which continent gets which colour. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 「五色加白能覆盖所有国旗色」这个说法在色彩学上是站不住的，但因为足够简洁，它比原版解释流传得更广。体育组织的象征解释往往要兼顾一百多个成员，模糊一点反而是必要的。
items.funEn: That five colours plus white cover every flag is not defensible in colour-theory terms, but being simpler it has travelled further than the original explanation. A sports organisation's symbolism has to satisfy over a hundred members, and a degree of vagueness is a requirement rather than a flaw.

items.histZh: 奥运红是五环里偏玫红的那一个环，比正红冷、比粉深。在五个环里，它的色相最接近品红，跟旁边的黄、绿、蓝放在一起时对比最强烈。五环的排列顺序和颜色都是固定的，改动任何一个都会立刻被看出来 —— 这也让这套图形成了世界上最容易被记住的标志之一。屏幕上的值是近似值。
items.histEn: Olympic red is the rose-leaning ring: cooler than a true red, deeper than a pink. Among the five it sits closest to magenta, and beside the yellow, green and blue it produces the strongest contrast in the set. The arrangement and colours of the rings are fixed, and any change is noticed immediately, which has made the mark one of the most easily remembered in the world. The value shown is an approximation.
items.funZh: 五环的互锁排列是设计上的关键：它不能只用颜色区分，必须靠交叠的图形本身说「连接」。所以即使打印成单色，这个标志依然成立 —— 这是一个图形在承担颜色做不了的工作。
items.funEn: The interlocking arrangement is the real design achievement: the mark cannot rely on colour alone, and the overlapping forms themselves have to say connected. It survives being printed in one colour, which is a graphic doing work that colour cannot.
